taxonomic_note: Accepted by current Kew treatment and native from South Texas into northeastern Mexico. The project currently has only Uvalde locked inside the target zone.
look_here_first: Start with the unusually colored flower: rose, pink, red, lavender, or occasionally pale petals above glaucous prickly foliage. Confirm Argemone with yellow latex plus prickly buds and capsules.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Uvalde is the exact project target-zone county locked in the current review. Broader South Texas occurrence is regional context only.

approval_exception.reason: Learner admission is independent from native-range certification.

best_field_traits: large rose, pink, red, lavender, or occasionally pale flowers
morphology_keys.comparison_training: Flower color is the quickest clue, but confirm with latex, bud, and capsule characters because pale-flowered individuals reduce the value of color alone.

comparisons.key_distinctions: Colored petals are the strongest first-pass cue; A. aurantiaca is especially distinctive for orange/reddish-orange latex.

photo_note: Exact diagnostic photo enrichment remains later polish; colored petals should be paired with fruit/bud views.
